result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: one major layout problem where content is clipped by the screen edge, and one minor issue where lower content is partially obscured by the bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: The restaurant card on the right side of the “Fastest near you” row is cut off by the screen edge, with its title and details not fully visible.
issues.suggestion: Add proper horizontal padding or make the row horizontally scrollable with clear card boundaries so the full card content can be viewed.

issues.description: The next restaurant card at the bottom is partially hidden behind the bottom navigation bar, making the content feel cramped.
issues.suggestion: Increase the bottom content padding or adjust the scroll area so cards aren’t obscured by the fixed navigation bar.
